asked_by: owner, 2026-09-04: per-level and per-league weights for MiLB performance
owner_expectation: AA > A+ > A > AAA > CPX > DSL

two_quantities.raw: rho(level-relative performance at L, first-6yr WAR), selected pool
two_quantities.incremental: the same with consensus FV and age partialled out; this is the quantity an eFV driver needs, because eFV already has the grade

environment_note: every rate is already level-relative to CONTEMPORANEOUS season-and-level norms, so a hitter-friendly league such as the PCL is normalised by its own league median before anything is compared. Part 3 asks whether a RESIDUAL league effect survives that; a second hand penalty on top would double-count.
